metadata.case_name: CHAN CHUN KEUNG v. CHIU KWOK KEUNG AND OTHERS

injuries.description: torn anterior cruciate and medical collateral ligaments of left knee
source: torn anterior cruciate and medical collateral ligaments of left knee
injuries.icd_description: Injury to multiple structures of knee

injuries.description: fracture of transverse process of 1st lumbar vertebra
source: fracture of transverse process of 1st lumbar vertebra

manifestations.description: scar which commences on inside of the left knee and curves forward for about 3" and then continues down the medial side of the lower leg for a further 3"
gross wasting of the thigh and slight wasting of the calf muscles of the left leg
severe knee pain and prolonged convalescence requiring physiotherapy and operation
remains unfit to resume any form of work which requires prolonged standing, walking or carrying heavy weights
permanent disability of 2% of whole man

treatments_received: admitted to Princess Margaret Hospital (shortly after 1981-11-02)
immobilisation of left knee in plaster cast
outpatient physiotherapy (3 times a week for a period of 6 months)
operation to repair torn ligaments of the left knee (10/07/1982)
use of walking stick and continued physiotherapy until end of May 1983

losses.description: Permanent injury to left knee with torn anterior cruciate and medial collateral ligaments; fracture of transverse process of 1st lumbar vertebra; gross wasting of thigh and slight wasting of calf muscles; resulting in 2% whole person permanent disability.
Scar on inside of left knee extending approximately 6 inches down medial side of lower leg.
Remains unfit to resume any form of work which requires prolonged standing, walking or carrying heavy weights.

comparable_cases.injury_description: Described by the judge as the nearest case to the present case; earlier award was $20,000 (judge adjusted for inflation in comparison).
